title: Crypto Market Structure
headline_read: How capital is rotating across the crypto market.

indicators.title: Large-vs-Small Rotation
indicators.context: Small- and mid-cap coins' market value relative to Bitcoin and Ether, indexed to 100 at the start of the window. Rising means alts are outperforming (risk-on); falling means a flight to the majors.
indicators.read: Small- and mid-cap coins are outperforming Bitcoin and Ether — a risk-on rotation into alts.

indicators.title: Bitcoin Dominance
indicators.context: Bitcoin's share of total cryptocurrency market value. A rising share signals caution; a falling share signals risk appetite. History accumulates daily.
indicators.read: Bitcoin is 54% of total crypto market value.

indicators.title: Bitcoin / Ether Ratio
indicators.context: The price of Bitcoin divided by the price of Ether — which of the two largest coins is leading. Sourced from FRED's decade-long price history.
indicators.read: Bitcoin has gained on Ether over the past year (ratio 20.97).
